resources.string: You can still read messages and see people you follow — without the feed that goes on forever.

NoScroll checks which app is in the foreground so it can show your shield screen when you open an app you have chosen to set aside. It cannot read the contents of any app, and never taps or acts inside one.
NoScroll can\'t step in until its accessibility service is turned on in Android\'s settings. Nothing below will be enforced until you do this.
